# AirToShare

> Instant file and text sharing across devices — on the same Wi‑Fi, via share link, or in a collaborative Room. No install required; optional free accounts unlock higher limits and My Shares.

AirToShare is a web-based file and text sharing app. Guests can share immediately without signing up. Logged-in users get a personal dashboard, favourites, longer expiry options, and public gallery links.

## Core features

- **File & text sharing**: Drag-and-drop uploads or paste text; switch between Text and Files tabs
- **Same Wi‑Fi sync**: Devices on the local network see the same session automatically
- **Share links**: Each share has a unique URL at `/s/{uuid}`; copy link or show QR code
- **Rooms**: Create or join a session with a 6-character code (`/r/{CODE}`); real-time clipboard sync
- **Password protection**: Optional bcrypt password gate on shares and rooms (rate-limited verify)
- **End-to-end encryption (E2EE)**: Optional client-side text encryption; decryption key stays in URL fragment (`#k=...`), never sent to server
- **Public gallery**: Account owners can enable read-only public pages at `/p/{slug}`
- **My Shares**: Account dashboard at `/account/shares` — manage shares, favourites, expiry, public links
- **Chunked uploads**: Large files (>5 MB) upload in resumable chunks (up to 500 MB per file)
- **File previews**: Inline and fullscreen previews for images, PDFs, and video
- **Real-time updates**: Live sync for uploads, text edits, and room clipboard (Laravel Reverb WebSockets)
- **PWA & dark mode**: Installable progressive web app; theme toggle with persistence
- **Auto expiry**: Shares clean up after expiry or inactivity; guests have shorter windows than accounts

## Limits (typical)

| Tier | Active files | Storage | Notes |
|------|-------------|---------|-------|
| Guest (IP) | 25 | — | Instant, no sign-up |
| Account | 100 | 1 GB | Email verification required; up to 30-day expiry |

Standard upload: up to 25 MB per file. Chunked pipeline: up to 500 MB per file.

## Public pages (indexable)

- [Home](https://airtoshare.app/): Main sharing workspace
- [How It Works](https://airtoshare.app/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide (Wi‑Fi, share links, rooms, security)
- [FAQ](https://airtoshare.app/faq): Help center — accounts, security, features, troubleshooting
- [Feedback](https://airtoshare.app/feedback): Contact support, bug reports, feature requests
- [Blog](https://airtoshare.app/blog): Feature announcements and guides
- [Sitemap](https://airtoshare.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap

## Private / noindex routes (not for search indexing)

These URLs are transactional or user-specific and are marked `noindex, nofollow`:

- `/s/{uuid}` — share view
- `/r/{code}` — room join
- `/p/{slug}` — public gallery (when enabled; still noindex)
- `/auth/*` — login, register, email verification
- `/account/*` — logged-in dashboard
- `/download/{uuid}` — direct file download

## Accounts

1. **Register** at `/auth/register` (email + password, 8+ characters)
2. **Verify email** via link sent to inbox (expires in 60 minutes; resend available)
3. **Log in** at `/auth/login` → **My Shares** at `/account/shares`
4. Guest content uploaded before registration can be claimed when logging in on the same site URL

## Technology

- **Backend**: Laravel (PHP), SQLite/MySQL
- **Frontend**: Blade templates, vanilla JavaScript modules
- **Real-time**: Laravel Reverb + Laravel Echo (WebSockets)
- **Storage**: Local disk with scheduled expiry cleanup
- **API**: REST API v2 (API key auth for programmatic access)
- **Security**: CSRF, rate limits, password gates, optional E2EE, security headers middleware

## How it works (short)

1. Open AirToShare in any modern browser
2. Add files or text; optionally set password, E2EE, expiry, or create a Room
3. Share via same Wi‑Fi auto-sync, copy `/s/…` link, QR code, or room code
4. Content expires automatically; password-protected shares require verification first
